35685664.headline_result: group C (iterative reconstruction-guided TCM) moderate/severe obstruction rate 5.18% vs 18.75% (group A)
35685664.study_design: prospective/retrospective comparative treatment study using AI-based CT reconstruction

35707042.model_family: deep learning belief network (compared to CNN, SVM)
35707042.clinical_problem: use MRI-based deep learning to evaluate serum bile acid profile and adverse perinatal outcomes in intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy
35707042.patient_population: 50 women with ICP, 50 healthy pregnant controls, 50 with cholelithiasis
35707042.model_description: Deep learning belief network (DLBN), built by stacking restricted Boltzmann machines, extracts features from liver MRI images in pregnant women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy to classify serum bile acid profile patterns, compared against CNN and SVM, and correlated with adverse perinatal outcomes.
35707042.headline_result: DLBN error rate 7.68% vs CNN 21.34% and SVM 22.41%
35707042.study_design: retrospective case-control study with deep learning model comparison

35785081.model_family: recurrent neural network (transfer learning from VGG16)
35785081.clinical_problem: automate interpretation of lung ultrasound for diagnosis of pulmonary diseases in neonates and children
35785081.patient_population: neonates and children undergoing lung ultrasound
35785081.model_description: Recurrent neural network using transfer learning from a modified VGG16 model with an improved loss function classifies lung diseases from clinical lung ultrasound images/video in neonates and children.

35821428.model_family: deep learning + geometric algorithm + machine learning classifiers (8 compared, best random forest)
35821428.clinical_problem: differentiate hypo-/hypertelorism from normal fetuses using automated MRI ocular biometric measurements and machine learning classification
35821428.patient_population: 296 fetuses (244 normal, 52 abnormal), 22-40 weeks gestational age, scanned 2008-2020
35821428.model_description: A fully automatic deep learning and geometric algorithm pipeline measures fetal ocular biometrics (binocular/inter-ocular/ocular diameters and volume) from MRI, and a random forest classifier uses these plus two novel computed ratios to classify hypo-/hypertelorism versus normal.
35821428.dataset_size: 296 fetuses (238 training implied, 58 independent test set)
35821428.headline_result: random forest AUC-ROC 0.941, F1 0.711 vs conventional criteria AUC-ROC 0.650
35821428.study_design: retrospective diagnostic model development and validation

35974072.exclusion_reason: Ophthalmic optical coherence tomography imaging (posterior vitreous); excluded non-radiologic imaging modality.

35997924.clinical_problem: evaluate pediatric pneumonia from chest radiographs using deep learning
35997924.patient_population: benchmark pediatric pneumonia chest radiograph dataset
35997924.model_description: Ensemble of deep capsule neural networks with interleaved convolutional and capsule layers, stitched together with dense layers, classifies pediatric pneumonia from chest radiographs.
35997924.study_design: retrospective model development and benchmark evaluation

36045635.clinical_problem: differentiate invasive placenta (placenta accreta spectrum) from noninvasive using MRI radiomics in high-risk pregnant women
36045635.patient_population: 181 pregnant women with suspected placenta accreta spectrum (125 training, 56 test)
36045635.model_description: Radiomics features extracted independently from HASTE and TRUFISP MRI sequences are combined with clinical and radiographic features (placental thickness) into a combined model predicting invasive placenta status.
36045635.study_design: retrospective diagnostic radiomics model development and validation

36085766.exclusion_reason: EEG dataset, not imaging; explicitly excluded modality (EEG signals).

36086471.clinical_problem: predict MYCN gene amplification status in pediatric neuroblastoma from CT-based radiomic features to aid prognosis and treatment planning
36086471.model_description: Random forest classifier uses radiomic features extracted from CT slices to classify MYCN gene amplification status in pediatric neuroblastoma patients.

36155489.clinical_problem: guide sonographers to accurately and quickly obtain standard diagnostic planes for fetal brain malformation screening
36155489.model_description: RLNet, a deep learning-based regression location network, tracks the current scanning plane position within a real-time 3D fetal head model, guiding the sonographer to acquire the three standard diagnostic planes for fetal brain malformation.
36155489.headline_result: average angle error of transthalamic plane 3.91+/-2.86 degrees
36155489.study_design: retrospective/prospective methods development and evaluation study

36263646.exclusion_reason: AI model uses temperament questionnaire signal data (converted to wavelet-transform images), not radiological imaging.

36264961.clinical_problem: evaluate use of non-expert (student) annotators for labeling pediatric wrist fracture bounding boxes to build AI training datasets
36264961.patient_population: 7000 pediatric wrist radiographs annotated over 10 days by students with/without medical background
36264961.model_description: Not an AI diagnostic model itself; evaluates the process of training non-expert students to annotate bounding boxes for pediatric wrist fractures on radiographs, intended for building supervised AI training datasets, with specialist feedback and correction time measured over training days.
36264961.study_design: prospective annotator training/evaluation study for AI dataset curation

36292119.exclusion_reason: General benchmarking of CNN model performance across six unrelated public datasets (pathology, dermoscopy, retinopathy, pediatric CXR, breast ultrasound, general CXR); not a pediatric-focused clinical study.

36378257.exclusion_reason: Editorial about prenatal detection of congenital heart defects generally; no AI/ML content evident (abstract empty, title does not reference AI).

36507139.clinical_problem: diagnose and grade severity of community-acquired pneumonia in children using lung ultrasound
36507139.patient_population: 89 children prospectively enrolled (65 CAP: 44 mild, 21 severe; 24 non-CAP), 916 LUS images
36507139.model_description: Convolutional neural networks (AlexNet, VGG16/19, Inception v3, ResNet18/50, DenseNet121/201) pretrained and fine-tuned via transfer learning classify and grade community-acquired pneumonia severity from pediatric lung ultrasound images, benchmarked against clinical diagnosis, chest X-ray, and CT.
36507139.study_design: prospective cohort study with CNN model development and cross-validation

36527632.clinical_problem: improve image reconstruction speed and accuracy for near-infrared optical tomography used to detect brain oxygenation abnormalities in preterm infants
36527632.model_description: Hybrid CNN based on V-net architecture reconstructs volumetric near-infrared optical tomography images from surface tissue measurements, jointly learning inclusion localization and absorption coefficients to detect brain oxygenation changes in preterm infants.
36527632.headline_result: reconstruction time 30.45s (89% time reduction), average Dice score 0.61
36527632.study_design: in-silico methods development and validation study

36536838.model_family: naive Bayes (compared with logistic regression, MLP, SVM, random forest)
36536838.clinical_problem: predict uterine dehiscence/rupture risk in patients with prior cesarean delivery using transabdominal ultrasound measurements of lower uterine segment thickness plus clinical features
36536838.patient_population: 317 term singleton pregnancies with prior cesarean delivery
36536838.model_description: Machine learning classifiers (naive Bayes performed best, also logistic regression, MLP, SVM, random forest) predict uterine dehiscence using transabdominal ultrasound-measured lower uterine segment full thickness and myometrium thickness combined with demographic and obstetric clinical features.
36536838.headline_result: naive Bayes correct classification rate 95.3%, F-score 0.952
36536838.study_design: retrospective cohort study with machine learning model development, 10-fold cross-validation

36575291.clinical_problem: overview of non-invasive cardiac imaging (echocardiography, CT, MRI) technical advances and role of AI in children and adolescents with congenital/acquired heart disease
36575291.patient_population: children and adolescents with congenital and acquired cardiac disease
36575291.model_description: Narrative review summarizing technical advances in echocardiography, cardiac CT, and cardiac MRI (including fetal cardiac MRI) for pediatric cardiac imaging, with a section on the anticipated role of artificial intelligence in data acquisition and interpretation.

36605438.body_region: whole body (hematological malignancy imaging, e.g., brain lymphoma/glioma)
36605438.clinical_problem: scoping review of machine learning applications to imaging in hematological malignancy diagnosis, segmentation, and prognostication, in pediatric and adult patients
36605438.patient_population: pediatric and adult patients with suspected/confirmed hematological malignancy undergoing imaging, 53 eligible studies
36605438.model_description: Scoping review of 53 studies applying diverse machine learning techniques (diagnosis/differentiation, segmentation, prognostication) to radiological imaging of hematological malignancies such as lymphoma and glioma, in pediatric and adult populations, assessed for methodological quality and bias.

36643818.clinical_problem: predict where a sonographer should look next during first-trimester fetal ultrasound scanning to improve training and scanning guidance
36643818.model_description: Spatio-temporal convolutional LSTM U-Net (cLSTMU-Net) predicts sonographer visual gaze/saliency maps frame-by-frame on first-trimester fetal ultrasound video, trained using expert gaze-tracking data and stochastic data augmentation.
36643818.study_design: retrospective methods development and evaluation study

39086969.exclusion_reason: Urine metabolomic gestational dating model (LC-MS + gradient boosting); no imaging/AI-on-images component, ultrasound mentioned only as a comparison reference standard.

33399387.clinical_problem: review of 3D ultrasound techniques for examining fetal brain views, including central nervous system malformations, with discussion of emerging AI applications
33399387.model_description: Narrative review describing 3D ultrasound acquisition and analysis techniques for fetal brain examination, including discussion of emerging artificial intelligence and deep machine learning applications for quantitative assessment of fetal cortical development.

34297499.exclusion_reason: General review of adrenal gland imaging anatomy and pathology; radiomics/AI mentioned only briefly as an emerging technique, not the review's focus.

34476423.clinical_problem: predict sonographer visual gaze on individual frames of first-trimester fetal ultrasound to identify important spatio-temporal scanning patterns
34476423.patient_population: 115 first-trimester ultrasound videos (29,250 training, 7,290 validation, 9,126 test frames)
34476423.model_description: Encoder-decoder convolutional neural network with skip connections predicts per-frame sonographer visual gaze/saliency on first-trimester fetal ultrasound video frames, using automated stochastic data augmentation policy search.
34476423.study_design: retrospective methods development and evaluation study

34476558.clinical_problem: assess impact of data input method (direct upload vs. smartphone photo) on the agreement/reliability of a deep learning bone age prediction app
34476558.patient_population: 50 hand radiographs across 5 bone age groups
34476558.model_description: 16Bit Bone Age app is a browser-based deep learning application that predicts bone age from pediatric hand radiographs; this study compares prediction agreement across three data input methods (direct upload, smartphone photo in reading room, smartphone photo in clinic).
34476558.release_evidence: The 16Bit Bone Age app is a browser-based deep learning application for predicting bone age on pediatric hand radiographs
34476558.study_design: prospective reliability/agreement study of a commercial deep learning application

34490419.exclusion_reason: Signal-processing analysis of Doppler-derived fetal heart rate variability features; not an imaging-based AI model (FHR is a non-imaging physiological signal, similar to ECG).

34593486.exclusion_reason: Study protocol for blood-protein biomarker discovery using machine learning; chest radiographs used only as part of clinical case definition criteria, not as AI input; protocol has no results.

34630983.exclusion_reason: Retracted publication; excluded due to retraction (data reliability concerns), despite topical relevance to pediatric CT AI diagnosis.

34712293.clinical_problem: screen echocardiographic indicators using an AI convolutional neural network to aid diagnosis of symptomatic patent ductus arteriosus in premature infants, correlated with serum NT-proBNP
34712293.patient_population: 90 premature infants (52 non-PDA, 38 PDA: 26 symptomatic, 12 asymptomatic)
34712293.model_description: An artificial intelligence convolutional neural network (AI-CNN) is used to screen echocardiographic indicators in premature infants, correlating findings with serum NT-proBNP levels to aid diagnosis of symptomatic patent ductus arteriosus.
34712293.study_design: retrospective cohort correlation study using AI-CNN-assisted echocardiography

34745322.clinical_problem: predict neurodevelopmental outcomes in school-aged children with tetralogy of Fallot using brain MRI radiomics
34745322.patient_population: school-aged TOF patients and healthy peer controls
34745322.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from brain MRI, reduced via LASSO regression, are used in a logistic regression model to predict neurodevelopmental status in school-aged children with corrected tetralogy of Fallot.
34745322.study_design: case-control validation study using radiomics model

34883969.model_family: Faster R-CNN with Oriented Bounding Box + Global-Local Fusion Segmentation Network
34883969.clinical_problem: automatically segment individual bones on pediatric elbow radiographs as an upstream task for automated fracture interpretation
34883969.model_description: A detection-segmentation pipeline uses a Faster R-CNN-style network with oriented bounding boxes to detect individual bones on pediatric elbow radiographs, followed by a Global-Local Fusion Segmentation Network that combines global and local context to segment overlapping bones.
34883969.study_design: retrospective methods development study on self-constructed dataset
